topic: Nature, Scope and Importance of Management
title: Why Management Never Stops | Principles of Management Ep 2
description:
What happens when nobody manages? Ravi leaves his chai stall for one week, and by Saturday sales have dropped by half. In this animated lesson we use Chai Corner to understand the nature, scope and importance of management in the simplest way possible.

You will learn the nature of management (goal-oriented, a group activity, continuous, intangible and universal), its scope (production, marketing, finance and HR, with the five functions running through every area), and why it matters (it meets goals, cuts waste and cost, builds a strong organization and helps society).

This is Episode 2 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.

In this video:
0:00 Ravi takes a week off
0:19 Nature, scope and importance
0:31 The nature of management
1:07 The scope of management
1:39 Why management matters
2:07 Quick check
2:22 Recap

Next episode: Management as Art, Science and Profession.
